overview.description: The WisdomTree India Earnings Fund (EPI) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the WisdomTree India Earnings index. The fund tracks a total market index of Indian companies selected and weighted by earnings. EPI was launched on Feb 22, 2008 and is issued by WisdomTree.
